collections.title: The opening narration
collections.where: A card shown once when a new campaign world starts, before the player has control
collections.how: Automatic: shown on the first launch of a new world (not shown again once dismissed).
collections.prereq: A new campaign world with a mentor cast.
collections.summary: Three paragraphs that set the scene: six winters of apprenticeship, magic is rare but does not make a ruler, the mentor has sent for you.

collections.title: The Mentor: introduction, lessons and the creed question
collections.where: In the home settlement, standing near the square
collections.how: Walk up to the mentor and press E (or click and choose Talk).
collections.prereq: None for the first talk. Each lesson unlocks the next. The creed question needs the first talk only.
collections.characters: Mentor (authored); Mira may be mentioned; the apprentice (you)
collections.summary: The mentor greets you, teaches the three colours, lets you break a Ward you are told, then a hidden Ward, and asks why wizards do not rule. Skill questions about Wards, the staff's glow and fracture/echo reading reveal secrets the stranger scene later uses. After the lessons the mentor points you at the village.

collections.title: The Forest Dispute (quest)
collections.status: Playable (needs a woodcutter, a forester and a witness in the settlement)
collections.where: Wherever the three chosen villagers happen to be working
collections.how: Ask the mentor 'What should I do now?' after the lessons (it names the three people), or just talk to the woodcutter or forester.
collections.prereq: Stories unlocked (all four lessons done or 20 game-minutes). The settlement needs a lumberjack, a ranger and a witness (soldier, else stonemason/hunter, else carrier).
collections.characters: Woodcutter, Forester, Witness (ordinary villagers cast from the simulation)
collections.summary: A woodcutter and a forester have fallen out over felling young trees. Hear both, optionally ask the witness, then choose: compromise, back the woodcutter, back the forester, or stay out.

collections.title: The Missing Granite (quest)
collections.status: Playable (needs a stonemason and a carrier)
collections.where: Wherever the mason and the carrier are
collections.how: Talk to the stonemason or carrier once stories are unlocked.
collections.prereq: Stories unlocked. A stonemason and a carrier in the settlement.
collections.summary: A mason says a load of granite never arrived; a carrier says it did. Back the mason (costs the warehouse a real load of granite), back the carrier, or work out where it went (Reason check).

collections.title: The Patrol (quest)
collections.status: Playable (needs a forester; a guard is optional)
collections.where: Wherever the forester and the guard are
collections.how: Talk to the forester or the guard once stories are unlocked.
collections.prereq: Stories unlocked. A ranger in the settlement; a soldier is optional.
collections.summary: A forester prepares a patrol of the valley's edge and wants a guard to walk with them.

collections.title: The warehouse keeper and the rats
collections.where: Beside the home settlement's central warehouse
collections.how: Talk to the keeper. Rats around the warehouse can be fought (Ward duels).
collections.prereq: The campaign has started. The keeper reads what the rats have done and what wizards have done about them.
collections.summary: Rats are eating the stores. The keeper complains, reacts to who fights them, to cooperation, to fire, and rewards a cleared warehouse. A smaller wave returns later.

collections.title: The apprentice's mother
collections.where: In the home settlement; she walks to a grounded apprentice
collections.how: She is cast beside each new apprentice. If a wizard kills their friend at home, she confronts them and grounds them until the friend is brought back.
collections.prereq: A wizard has killed another wizard within the home territory (for the grounding lines); otherwise she greets.
collections.summary: Her lines escalate with what the apprentice has done: kills, protests, resurrections and deaths. She refuses to let them walk away from a dead friend.

collections.title: The stranger: arrival, confrontation, duel and retreat
collections.how: Automatic: after enough exploring (3 minutes and 3 contacts, or 7 minutes regardless) when nothing else owns the player.
collections.prereq: The lessons are over (or 5 minutes passed, or a wizard duel/death happened). Nothing else open (no conversation, duel or dungeon).
collections.characters: The stranger (authored), the mentor, the apprentice, Mira (optional line)
collections.summary: A stranger in a dark cloak kills the mentor in front of the village. The apprentice may answer with a belief, challenge him to a lethal Ward duel, or let him go. A verified win makes him retreat alive; a loss is the apprentice's death.

collections.title: After the stranger: what the villagers say
collections.where: Any ordinary villager, worker, carrier or soldier of the settlement
collections.how: Talk to any villager after the stranger has been driven off.
collections.prereq: Campaign stage victory, aftermath or complete.
collections.summary: Each person speaks first about the attack, chosen by their trade, what they saw (witnessed, rumour) and their personality. Topics offer Aspect checks (Curiosity, Empathy, Authority, Guile, Reason) and ideological replies.

collections.title: Everyday talk by occupation
collections.where: Any ordinary lumberjack, forester, stonemason, hunter, carrier or soldier; any other worker
collections.how: Walk up and press E; click and choose Talk. A worker inside a building must be asked out first.
collections.prereq: None; topics appear only when their conditions hold in the live simulation.
collections.summary: Seven occupation sets: an introduction, greetings and 4-8 topics each, plus topics shared by everyone (opinions of the mentor, wizards, apprentices, thanks, road rumours, a rare fourth-wall remark).

collections.title: The Trial gate: the Rollkeeper and the contestants
collections.where: At the Trial's gate east of the village, and inside the first zone
collections.how: Walk to the gate and talk to the Rollkeeper; talk to the contestants in the entrance zone.
collections.prereq: The Trial gate exists in the world (campaign). Entering needs a wizard who is not grounded.
collections.characters: Rollkeeper (official), a knight, an elf, Throm, a barbarian, an assassin
collections.summary: The Rollkeeper registers contestants and warns about the Trial; contestants speak in the entrance zone.

collections.title: The Trial of Champions (zones, signs, choices)
collections.status: Playable (zones A to K; some passages unverified)
collections.how: Enter through the gate; walk and interact with signs, people and objects.
collections.prereq: Enter the gate. Many choices depend on earlier choices in the same run (shared by all wizards in the run).
collections.characters: Throm, the Dwarf Trialmaster, the old man, the dying elf, Poison Ivy, the Basket man, Igbut, ritual elder and others
collections.summary: Fifteen choice events with consequences: wounds, allies, learned facts, items, a champion's exit.

collections.title: Mira, the AI fellow apprentice
collections.status: Playable (single-player only; the AI seat is the second seat)
collections.where: Follows the human wizard everywhere, including into the Trial
collections.how: Automatic in single player. Challenge her to a duel; she declines twice and accepts the third time.
collections.prereq: A single-player hosted world (the AI seat exists).
collections.summary: She greets, declines challenges, duels, reacts to wins/losses/death, resurrects friends, helps with rats and follows into the Trial.

collections.title: System and presentation text (toasts, fallbacks, journal notes)
collections.how: Triggered by events: deaths, resurrections, notices, refusals, journal entries.
collections.summary: Fallback lines, refusals, toasts and journal notes written by the code rather than by dialogue data.

collections.title: Legacy story layer: the collapsed gallery (miner quest)
collections.status: Partially reachable: appears only if the simulation collapses a mine
collections.how: A miner appears when a working mine's gallery collapses (tremor, war damage, age). Talk to the miner.
collections.prereq: A mine collapse in the live simulation. Not on demand.
collections.summary: The miner explains the fall, tells of an old gallery, hands over a sigil, and an Empathy check can earn extra casts in the warden's Mastermind duel.

collections.title: Legacy story layer: the outbreak healer
collections.status: Partially reachable: appears only if the simulation produces an outbreak
collections.where: In a settlement whose region holds two or more outbreak marks
collections.how: A healer appears; talk to them and accept to treat the region.
collections.prereq: An outbreak (two or more marks) in a standing settlement's region.
collections.summary: The healer reports the outbreak; the wizard accepts and stands in the region to treat it, or says they cannot help.
